(2) A transition whoosh SFX occurs as the music shifts into a J-Pop anime rock anthem featuring male and female vocalists singing in Japanese. The drums are prominent and driving. (3) A brief female voice interjects with high excitement, speaking in Traditional Chinese about feeling like they are 'dying' from effort or humor. The music ducks slightly to accommodate the speech. (4) The J-Pop track continues with full spectral energy, characterized by bright synthesizers and distorted guitars, maintaining a high-arousal heroic vibe through the end of the clip.
